Original fixture prose for Latchkit's test suite. This file sits at
`openspec/specs/scratch/spec.md` — the location a current spec would use —
but its content is unrelated freeform notes, not an OpenSpec requirements
document. It must not be classified as a supported capability spec just
because of its filename and location.
